Chess Arena is built on the MERN stack! The frontend uses React 19, Vite, chess.js for validation, react-chessboard, and a Minimax engine running in a Web Worker.
Under the hood: React + Vite frontend, an alpha-beta pruning Minimax chess engine running on a background worker thread, and a Node.js + Express backend.
Tech stack highlights: React with custom hooks, CSS grid dark theme, chess.js rules engine, react-chessboard for DnD, and client-side minimax calculations.
Opening Principle: Control the center squares (e4, d4, e5, d5), develop knights before bishops, and castle early for king safety!
Tactical Tip: Look for undefended pieces! Before making your move, always check if your opponent has checks, captures, or threats (CCT).
Endgame Rule: In pawn endgames, king activity is paramount. Activate your king and push passed pawns as quickly as possible.
Piece Mobility: A knight on the rim is dim! Keep your knights and bishops pointed toward the center of the board.
Patience: When you see a good move, wait and look for an even better one!
My chess engine runs at 3 difficulty levels: Easy (~1200 ELO, depth 1), Medium (~1500 ELO, depth 2), and Hard (~1800 ELO, depth 3). You can switch difficulty anytime!
Right now, you can challenge me across Easy (1200), Medium (1500), and Hard (1800) levels. Depth 3 calculates several moves ahead with alpha-beta pruning!
I evaluate material and positional piece-square tables. Change my depth in the controls panel on the right to test your skills.
